summary: Feed s078_single is degraded due to high encrypted traffic share (93.1% vs 90% NDR tolerance). All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, VLAN) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Traffic mix is dominated by TLS-encrypted flows (93% of bytes). No decryption/SSL visibility is performed before the packet broker forwards to the NDR, so payloads arrive opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep inspection and behavioral detection. With 93% encrypted bytes above its 90% tolerance, it can only use metadata/flow heuristics and misses threats hidden inside encryption (malware, C2, exfiltration), reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypting authorized TLS at the visibility layer (or via dedicated decryption zone) before the NDR restores cleartext payload for inspection where policy allows, bringing encrypted share below 90% tolerance and restoring NDR detection efficacy without violating privacy/policy.
